description: This Java source file defines the class JsonPointerInvalidException, a custom exception used to indicate invalid JSON Pointer formats within the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It includes builder methods for creating instances with specific messages related to JSON Pointer errors.

classes.name: JsonPointerInvalidException
classes.description: A final class extending JsonRuntimeException, representing an exception for invalid JSON Pointer formats.

classes.name: JsonPointerInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing JsonPointerInvalidException instances with specific messages and properties.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for creating JsonPointerInvalidException instances.

methods.name: newBuilderForConsecutiveSlashes
methods.description: Returns a builder preconfigured with a message indicating that consecutive slashes are not supported in JSON pointers.

methods.name: newBuilderForOuterSlashes
methods.description: Returns a builder preconfigured with a message indicating that leading or trailing slashes are not supported in JSON pointers.

methods.name: jsonPointer
methods.description: Sets a message pointing to the invalid JSON pointer, indicating it is invalid.

methods.name: doBuild
methods.description: Constructs and returns a JsonPointerInvalidException instance with the specified properties.
